content.text: Please refresh the page to get the latest updates.Nouna type of seating that has two high-backed benches with a table between them, usually found at bars, cafes, or restaurants"booth" Example SentencesI reserved a booth at our favorite restaurant for my wife's birthday.There aren't any private booths available, but there is some space at the bar."booth" Related Lesson MaterialAnd the private place inside the polling station where you cast your vote is called a "polling booth" or a "voting booth."See LessonGrandmaster Thomas Booth is the owner of EMAA.See LessonAstronauts sleep in a box the size of a telephone booth on the ISS.See LessonThomas Booth designed his restaurant to represent medieval times.See LessonThomas Booth also operates a restaurant in Old Town Alexandria.See LessonThe company has not yet said how much booth tickets will cost.See LessonThe clerks at the taxi reservation booth will provide all the information you need.See LessonLocal cosmetics companies pay about $220 a month for their products to be in the booth.See LessonIn my youth we'd go down to the pub, sit in a booth and talk all night.See LessonHe is a Professor of Behavioral Science and Economics at the University of Chicago Booth School of Business, Illinois.See LessonBrowse wordsRelated WordsNouna small space or room that allows for privacy or separation from others
